answer: Reaching eligibility takes 31 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The summit register is checked at draw time, river lists the eligible set, and whisper seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 31 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 158 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
